name: Bridgepointe Flooring & Painting — Color Tokens
notes: Logo colors sampled directly from public/images/logo.png with ImageMagick. Website palette mirrors src/app/globals.css.

navy.use: Primary brand navy. Wordmark 'BRIDGE'. Use for headlines, primary buttons, dark UI surfaces.

navy-deep.use: Emblem fill (bridge silhouette). Slightly cooler/darker than wordmark navy. Use sparingly for emblem reproductions and very dark surfaces.

green.use: Primary brand green. Wordmark 'POINTE' and brush stroke body. Use for accents, secondary CTAs, success states, paint-related callouts.

green-bright.use: Accent green highlight from the location pin / brush highlights. Use for hover states, badges, charts. Do NOT use for body text on light backgrounds (low contrast).

charcoal.use: Body text on warm-white. Dark surfaces. Primary foreground.

charcoal-light.use: Secondary dark surface. Card backgrounds on dark sections.

warm-white.use: Primary background. Body color of the site.

warm-white-dark.use: Secondary surface. Subtle section bands, hover backgrounds.

gold.use: Legacy accent (pre-rebrand). Use only when matching existing site components. Prefer logo green for new accents.

gold-light.use: Light gold tint. Borders, subtle dividers on dark surfaces.

gold-dark.use: Dark gold. Hover state for gold buttons.

slate.use: Muted body text. Captions on warm-white.

cream.use: Lightest surface. Modal backgrounds, elevated cards.
